📽️ Detailed Logo Animation Prompt: TOTALGAS

Goal: Create a clean, professional, and impactful animation for the TOTALGAS logo, emphasizing the orange frame and bold text. The animation should be around 4-6 seconds total (including an end hold).

1. The Opening Sequence (Entry - 2 seconds)

Background Fade & Stripe Sweep:

The background (white/light gray with diagonal stripes) starts at 0% opacity.

The diagonal gray stripes sweep in quickly from the top-left to the bottom-right, revealing the background. This should look like a fast, directional wipe.

Simultaneously, the main elements begin their entry.

The Orange Frame:

The outer orange rectangle (the large frame) draws itself on. It should look like two lines tracing out the rectangle, meeting at the corners.

Timing: The frame drawing should complete just as the "TOTALGAS" text animation begins.

The "TOTALGAS" Text:

The dark gray text "TOTALGAS" should appear using a masking/wipe effect that moves left-to-right. Imagine a solid gray block wiping across the frame, revealing the letters from left to right with a slight, smooth overshoot (a subtle easing motion).

The Subtitle Bar:

As "TOTALGAS" finishes, the thin orange line and the subtitle block directly below it appear.

The thin orange line should sweep in from the center outwards (split-sweep).

The subtitle text "EQUIPOS PARA GASTRONOMÍA" then fades up very quickly inside the orange block.

2. The Hold (Centerpiece - 1.5 seconds)

All elements hold steady in their final position, perfectly centered.

Suggestion: Add a very subtle, slow pulse/glow to the entire orange color (frame and subtitle box) to keep the logo feeling alive before the exit.

3. The Exit Sequence (Exit - 1.5 seconds)

Text & Subtitle Exit:

The subtitle block and text ("EQUIPOS PARA GASTRONOMÍA") collapse or shrink vertically back into the single thin orange line.

The main text "TOTALGAS" then disappears with a fast vertical downward motion (drops out of the frame).

The Orange Frame & Background Fade:

The outer orange rectangle dissolves or shrinks back towards the center very quickly.

Finally, the entire background (stripes) fades to black/white over the last half-second.
